solver_constraint: certified JOST_V2_2 + ECS_V2_2 only; NO algorithm/threshold changes; no solver reads the other's candidates
tiles_immutable: No box may be moved after any candidate inspection.

combined_coverage_after_completion.note: union with the already-scanned original box [0.05,1.5]x[-0.8,-0.05]; D1/D2/D3 are disjoint and complete the union

frequency_symmetry_check_required.question: does the spectrum obey omega -> -omega* under the current time convention+BCs?
frequency_symmetry_check_required.protocol: derive from the real-coefficient/operator structure BEFORE spending compute on Re<0; if YES, record the proof and the positive-Re search covers the mirror; if NO/unresolved, declare a separate negative-Re tile later. Do not assume silently.

discovery_protocol.jost: coarse-to-fine per tile; adaptive refinement rule declared algorithmically per tile BEFORE evaluation; store omega, Evans/log-derivative metric, scan spacing, refinement ladder, r_match stability, channel branch identities
discovery_protocol.ecs: independent residual-validated pairs only; track pencil residual, theta/tail/grid trajectories, continuum-band classification, stationarity; not every residual-valid eigenvalue is a resonance — must separate from the rotating continuum and pass the certified gates

matching_rule: only after all six candidate files hashed: common survivor of Jost candidate AND ECS stationary candidate AND all C-R gates

frequency_conventions.Omega_inf: omega_t / sqrt(f_inf) with the certified branch asymptotic normalization (f_inf=0.24588743 Richardson); the old +a1 factor is NOT used

outcomes.common_poles: CERTIFIED_RESONANCE_CATALOG_V2_(expanded) bound to solver certificate SHA + operator SHA + this preregistration SHA + candidate artifacts + Closure SHA; V1/V2 catalogs remain superseded

next_preregistered_ladder_if_empty: then branch (a1=-0.5,eps=+0.3) starting from the original small box
observational_seal: NICER/GWOSC stay fetched-but-sealed: no peak locations, no mass-derived windows, no detector features may influence D1/D2/D3 or refinement
continuous_execution: commit preregistration, then D1 Jost+ECS, D2, D3, freeze candidates, match, gates, verdict; stop only for genuine numerical failure, certificate violation, or branch/operator inconsistency
